_comment: Labeled ground truth (brief §8). The engine is run BLIND across full history; these labels are only compared against its output afterwards. Split 2026-07-02: account data begins 2025-11-20, so pre-history incidents cannot be backtested against pulled data and live in untestable_pre_history.

testable.name: Mar 13-17, 2026 post-pause learning reset (CPA +175%)
testable.window_note: first five delivering days after the 14-day delivery pause (acct-delivery-pause-2026-02-27)
testable.notes: Delivery resumption after the Feb 27 - Mar 12 pause reset ad-set learning; CVR-dominated CPA spike (Phase 1 blind detection: CPA +174.7%, CVR share of drift 72%, CTR 16%, CPM 11%). Advertiser-side cause: the pause/resume itself.

testable.name: May 24, 2026 checkout-event definition shift (rate x~6.5 overnight)
testable.window_note: persistent level shift, not a bounded incident; still active at data end
testable.notes: checkouts_initiated/inline_link_clicks steps 0.081 -> 0.400 in one day and persists (acct-checkout-event-shift-2026-05-24). Site/tracking-layer definition change. Purchases unaffected — a REPORTING-flavored funnel-instrumentation change the engine must distinguish from a real funnel break.

testable.name: Jun 25, 2026 checkout-entry drop (~21%)
testable.window_note: ongoing as of kickoff; measured against POST-May-24-shift checkout levels
testable.notes: publish suspected, causation unproven — the live case the engine must adjudicate; headline deliverable of Phase 4. Phase 1 blind detection flagged CPA +59.1% on 2026-06-26..28 (CVR 53% / CTR 26% / CPM 21% of drift).

untestable_pre_history._note: Account data begins 2025-11-20 (first delivery). These incidents predate pulled history and cannot be adjudicated against data; retained as institutional memory only.

incidents.name: eshkol link break (fbclid loss)
incidents.notes: attribution/tracking break — fbclid lost on landing

incidents.name: Spend-doubling auction inflation (CPA $171 era)
incidents.notes: auction response to advertiser's own spend increase; Herrmann hypothesis ruled out
